messages:
nina_pm: Quick sync 1: Acme asked for a "precision slice" EU low-latency variant behind a flag. They want EU-only month 1, then expand to APAC if stable. We need: slice plan, A/B cost checks, quality gates, fallbacks, and a short ops runbook.

carl_ops: Noted. eu capacity is tight mid-Nov. We'll reserve a dedicated 3-GPU pool for the canary window and allow burst to spot instances. We need an instant kill switch. Also decide: region routing + tenant allowlist vs tenant-only.

theo_eng: My take: region-routing + tenant allowlist is lowest risk. Proposal (orchestra slices): preflight shadow (mirror 100%) for 8h to warm caches, then slices: 1% for 4h -> 10% for 24h -> 40% for 48h -> 100% for 5d. Gate each step on latency, error, and quality.

maya_ml: Quality gates (we'll automate eval on mirrored outputs): human_like_score >= 0.92, hallucination_rate_delta < 0.7%, semantic-diff < 1.5%. I'll prepare a 200-prompt eval set covering long-context, multi-turn, and edge instructions.

eric_sre: Ops gates: p95_latency <= baseline + 25ms (sustained >30m triggers rollback check), error_rate <= baseline * 1.8. If gpu_pool_util > 80% route 50% of new canary sessions to KV-cache fallback (CPU fallback) while we investigate. Circuit breaker: sustained p95 > baseline + 100ms for 10m -> auto-kill. Add paging to #eng-oncall.

theo_eng: Also want a cost A/B: route 15% of canary traffic to quantized-q4 variant (mirrored) to compare cost and quality. Stop cost test if quality divergence > 1.5% after 24h or if savings < 10% at 24h. We'll record token_cost_per_1k and token_latency breakdown.

nina_pm: Draft flag config (ops/devex review):
```yaml
flag: acme_precision_slice_v1
enabled_for: ["acme_corp"]
regions: ["eu"]
preflight:
  mirror_duration: 8h
  warmup: true
slices:
  - pct: 1
    min_duration: 4h
  - pct: 10
    min_duration: 24h
  - pct: 40
    min_duration: 48h
  - pct: 100
    min_duration: 5d
cost_ab_test:
  pct: 15
  variant: quantized-q4
  stop_conditions:
    - quality_divergence_pct: 1.5
    - min_cost_savings_pct: 10
fallbacks:
  - when: "errors > baseline * 1.8 or p95 > baseline + 25ms"
    action: rollback
  - when: "gpu_util >= 80%"
    action: route_percent_to_kv_fallback: 50
emergency_controls:
  - kill_switch: true
  - ops_override: true
reporting_metrics: ["latency_p50","latency_p95","error_rate","human_like_score","hallucination_rate","token_cost_per_1k"]
```

carl_ops: Preflight must include long-context cache priming (6h of synthetic long sessions) and DB/cache priming for prefix caching. I'll reserve the pool and add a 24h buffer on the reservation.

eric_sre: Alerts: page #eng-oncall and #product-alerts for circuit-breaker. Runbook snippet: "1) flip kill_switch, 2) open rollback PR, 3) notify Acme CSM and account team, 4) escalate to infra lead if issue persists >30m." Add a postmortem template if we needed rollback.

theo_eng: I'll open the PR with routing middleware, mirror pipeline, and telemetry hooks (per-tenant breakdown, side-by-side diffs). ETA: 36h. I'll also add a lightweight dashboard with per-slice KPIs.

maya_ml: I'll post the eval prompt set by EOD and run the first shadow eval during preflight; will post a quality snapshot to this thread. Key: include adversarial prompts + long-context turn-taking.

deploy-bot: schedule: preflight_shadow start=2024-11-10T01:00:00Z id=pfl-1759997777.

nina_pm: Owners: theo (eng), carl (ops), maya (quality), eric (oncall). Action items: theo PR w/ flag & telemetry, carl reserve + warmup plan, maya publish eval set, eric add paging/runbook. Reconvene after preflight. :thumbsup:
